 viewport size

tables.name: Props
rows: Render function that will be called with the current viewport size (e.g our base theme of size 'small', 'medium', 'large'). The size value will be derived from global.breakpoints entry in the theme object.

tables.name: Theme
rows:
The possible breakpoints that could affect border, direction,
gap, margin, pad, and round. The default values help to optimize content for
mobile, tablet, and computer.
